Uttar Pradesh readies for Kanwar Yatra with extra buses, control room

The Uttar Pradesh government has begun preparations for the upcoming Shravan Maas Kanwar Yatra, scheduled to start on July 30. To ensure the pilgrimage is smooth and safe, the Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) will operate additional buses. A control room will remain active 24 hours a day for monitoring and to facilitate pilgrims.
